dogecoin.text: @rwallie @Xerberus_io @base @dogecoin My point was that substance does not matter as long as people are willing to provide liquidity consistently to form a stable market. It's strange, but it's true.

@rwallie @Xerberus_io @base If the world decided tomorrow to make @dogecoin the global reserve currency, it would have one of the most capitalised and stable markets and thus one of the best risk ratings, regardless of the effort or intention that went into the project.
